tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Use this when the user names an artist, team, venue or event and you need the matching TicketSea records. Ranked search with prefixes, aliases and labeled one-edit corrections. Artist and venue matches are worldwide; an event radius needs a city ID or a full City, Region, Country label. Events, arti

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Use this when the user wants upcoming concerts, sports, theatre or other live events by performer or event name, city, country, category or dates. Returns cached provider listings in date order. Each upcoming event has its TicketSea page (url) and a tickets link: the seller's page for that exact eve

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Use this when you have an event's slug from a search result and need that event's current details: date, local time, venue, sale state, cancellation and any published price range. Returns the newest available snapshot; older details are returned explicitly marked stale.

tools.name: get_ticket_links
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to buy or compare tickets for one specific event. Returns the exact-event seller links from a fresh, upcoming snapshot (links), each labeled primary or resale, official and affiliate, and the other sellers the event's TicketSea page offers (otherSellers), such as resale

tools.name: prepare_event_visit
tools.description: Use this when the user is planning a trip to one specific event and wants tickets together with a place to stay, parking or directions. One call returns the latest event details, every seller link for the event, the venue address, suggested stay dates and search links for hotels, parking, directions

tools.name: get_ticket_prices
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether tickets are getting cheaper or pricier, what it costs to get in, which events dropped or rose in price this week, or how an event's price has moved. Returns TicketSea's daily ticket price figures from TickPick's lowest listed all-in prices: the median get-in price

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Use this when a search fails or returns nothing unexpectedly and you need to know whether TicketSea's listings are current. Returns the latest snapshot time for each country. This is not a seller uptime or booking success measurement.
